description: The bar chart is titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Stress" and is designed to compare the runtime in seconds of different models. The vertical axis is labeled "Runtime (seconds)" and is linear, with a value range that extends from 0 to 400 seconds. The horizontal axis lists the names of the models: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLLaMA," and "Claude." The chart includes two sets of bars for each model, with the green bars representing "Our Joint Framework" and the sky blue bars representing "LLM Models." The runtime values are indicated above each bar. For "Our Joint Framework," the runtime is 77 seconds, while for "LLM Models," the runtimes are 190 seconds for "ChatGPT," 365 seconds for "DeepSeek," 172 seconds for "LLLaMA," and 243 seconds for "Claude." The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
